subject: ENGLISH
titleUz: Ingliz tili B1 — Grammatika to'liq kursi
descriptionUz: Multilevel (UzBMB) imtihoniga mo'ljallangan to'liq B1 grammatika kursi: zamonlar, modal fe'llar, shart gaplar, majhul nisbat, o'zlashtirma gap va boshqa asosiy tuzilmalar. Har bir dars chuqur o'zbekcha tushuntirish, jonli misollar, imtihon tuzoqlariga qarshi maslahatlar va avtomatik tekshiriladigan mashqlardan iborat.

modules.titleUz: Zamonlar mahorati: o'tgan, hozirgi va kelasi

lessons.titleUz: Past Simple va Past Continuous: nuqta va jarayon
objectivesUz: Past Simple va Past Continuous qachon ishlatilishini aniq farqlash
when va while bilan murakkab gaplar tuzish
O'tgan voqeani hikoya qilishda ikki zamonni birga qo'llash

content.bodyUz:
O'tgan zamonda ikki xil vaziyat bo'ladi:

**Past Simple** — tugallangan, bitta nuqtadagi harakat. O'zbekchadagi «-di» qo'shimchasiga to'g'ri keladi: *keldi, ko'rdi, ishladi*.
- *I watched a film yesterday.* — Kecha film ko'rdim. (boshladim va tugatdim — voqea yopiq)

**Past Continuous (was/were + V-ing)** — o'tgan zamondagi ma'lum paytda **davom etayotgan** jarayon. O'zbekchadagi «-ayotgan edi» shakliga mos: *ko'rayotgan edim, ishlayotgan edi*.
- *I was watching a film at 8 pm.* — Soat 8 da film ko'rayotgan edim. (jarayonning o'rtasida edim)

Vaqt chizig'ida tasavvur qiling: Past Simple — chiziqdagi bitta NUQTA (•), Past Continuous — cho'zilgan TO'LQINLI CHIZIQ (~~~~~), va biz o'sha chiziqning o'rtasiga qaraymiz.

content.bodyUz:
Hikoya qilishda ikkala zamon ko'pincha BITTA gapda keladi:

**Uzun (fon) harakat → Past Continuous; uni bo'lib yuborgan qisqa harakat → Past Simple:**
- *I was having dinner when the phone rang.* — Kechki ovqat yeyayotgan edim, telefon jiringladi.

Eng ishonchli formula: **while + Past Continuous**, **when + Past Simple**:
- *While I was walking home, I met my old teacher.* — Uyga ketayotganimda eski o'qituvchimni uchratdim.

Ikkita PARALLEL jarayon bo'lsa, ikkalasi ham Past Continuous bo'ladi:
- *While I was cooking, my sister was setting the table.* — Men ovqat pishirayotganimda, singlim dasturxon tuzayotgan edi.

content.bodyUz: Multilevel imtihonida bu mavzu Listening'dagi hikoya matnlarida va grammatika topshiriqlarida «when/while» tuzog'i sifatida keladi: while'dan keyin deyarli har doim Past Continuous, when'dan keyin esa ko'pincha Past Simple turadi. Writing Task 2 da o'tgan voqeani hikoya qilsangiz, fon uchun Past Continuous ishlatish («The sun was shining when...») grammatik diapazon balingizni sezilarli oshiradi.

content.titleUz: Present Perfect — o'zbek tilida yo'q zamon
content.bodyUz:
Present Perfect (**have/has + V3**) — o'zbek tilida AYNAN mos keladigan zamoni yo'q, shuning uchun eng ko'p qiynaydigan mavzu. Mohiyati: **harakat o'tmishda bo'lgan, lekin natijasi yoki aloqasi HOZIRGA tegishli**.

Vaqt chizig'ini tasavvur qiling: harakat o'tmishdagi noma'lum nuqtada sodir bo'lgan (•), lekin undan hozirgi paytga ko'rinmas ip tortilgan: • ——→ HOZIR. Bizni harakatning QACHON bo'lgani emas, HOZIRGA ta'siri qiziqtiradi.

- *I have lost my keys.* — Kalitlarimni yo'qotib qo'yganman. (Natija: HOZIR kalitim yo'q, uyga kirolmayapman!)
- *She has been to London.* — U Londonda bo'lgan. (Tajriba bor — qachonligi muhim emas)

O'zbekcha «-gan» shakli ko'pincha yordam beradi: *ko'rganman, borganman, yeganman* — bularda ham aniq vaqt aytilmaydi, xuddi Present Perfect kabi.

Harakat qancha vaqtdan beri davom etayotganini aytish uchun:

**for + davomiylik** (qancha vaqt?): *for two years, for six months, for a long time*
- *I have lived in Tashkent for five years.* — Toshkentda besh yildan beri yashayman.

**since + boshlanish nuqtasi** (qachondan beri?): *since 2020, since Monday, since childhood*
- *He has worked here since 2021.* — U bu yerda 2021-yildan beri ishlaydi.

Sodda test: so'zdan keyin MUDDAT (ikki yil, uch oy) tursa — **for**; SANA yoki PAYT (2020, dushanba, bolalik) tursa — **since**.

Diqqat: bunday gaplarni o'zbekchaga HOZIRGI zamon bilan tarjima qilamiz («yashayman», «ishlaydi») — chunki harakat hali ham davom etmoqda!

**ever** — «umuman, hayotingizda biror marta» — asosan so'roq gaplarda:
- *Have you EVER been to Samarkand?* — Umuman Samarqandda bo'lganmisiz?

**never** — «hech qachon» — darak gap shaklida inkor ma'no beradi (not qo'shilmaydi!):
- *I have NEVER ridden a horse.* — Hech qachon ot minmaganman.

Ikkalasi ham have/has bilan V3 ORASIDA turadi: have + ever/never + V3.

❌ *I haven't never seen...* — ikki marta inkor xato! ✅ *I have never seen...*

content.bodyUz: Multilevel Speaking Part 1 da «Have you ever...?» savollari juda ko'p uchraydi — javobda avval Present Perfect bilan tajribangizni ayting, keyin xohlasangiz tafsilotni Past Simple bilan davom ettiring. Grammatika bo'limida esa for/since tanlovi deyarli har yili bor: «muddat → for, boshlanish nuqtasi → since» qoidasini avtomatizmga yetkazing.

lessons.titleUz: Present Perfect vs Past Simple: imtihondagi eng katta tuzoq
objectivesUz: Vaqt ko'rsatkichiga qarab to'g'ri zamonni tanlash
Signal so'zlarni (yesterday, just, yet, ago...) zamonga bog'lash
Suhbatda ikki zamon almashinishini tushunish

content.bodyUz:
Bu ikki zamonni farqlash — multilevel imtihonida ENG KO'P tushadigan grammatik savol. Oltin qoida bitta:

**Aniq o'tgan vaqt aytilgan bo'lsa (yesterday, last year, in 2020, two days ago) → Past Simple.**
- *I visited Khiva last summer.* — vaqt aniq: o'tgan yozda.

**Vaqt aytilmagan, muhimi natija yoki tajriba bo'lsa → Present Perfect.**
- *I have visited Khiva.* — qachonligi muhim emas, tajribam borligi muhim.

Vaqt chizig'ida: Past Simple — o'tmishdagi YOPIQ nuqta, hozir bilan aloqasi uzilgan. Present Perfect — o'tmishdan hozirga tortilgan OCHIQ ko'prik.

1) **When? — har doim Past Simple.** «When have you arrived?» ❌ → *When did you arrive?* ✅ Chunki «qachon?» savoli aniq vaqtni so'raydi.

2) **Suhbatda zamon almashadi:** tajriba haqidagi umumiy savol — Present Perfect, tafsilotlar — Past Simple:
- *— Have you ever been to Bukhara? — Yes, I have. I went there in 2024 with my class.*

3) **Tugagan vaqt vs tugamagan vaqt:**
- *I drank three cups of tea yesterday.* (kecha — vaqt tugagan)
- *I have drunk three cups of tea today.* (bugun — kun hali tugamagan, yana ichishim mumkin!)

«this week, this month, today» kabi TUGAMAGAN davrlar bilan Present Perfect keladi.

content.bodyUz: Imtihon strategiyasi: gapda vaqt ko'rsatkichini qidiring. «ago, last..., in + yil, yesterday, when?» ko'rsangiz — javob Past Simple. «just, already, yet, ever, never, for, since» ko'rsangiz — Present Perfect. Shu bitta qoida grammatika bo'limida kamida 2-3 ball olib keladi, chunki test tuzuvchilar aynan shu farqni har yili so'raydi.

lessons.titleUz: Kelasi zamon: will, going to va Present Continuous
lessons.titleEn: Future forms: will / going to / Present Continuous
objectivesUz: will, going to va Present Continuous'ning kelasi zamondagi vazifalarini farqlash
Vaziyatga qarab (qaror, reja, bashorat, kelishuv) to'g'ri shaklni tanlash
Kelajak rejalari haqida tabiiy gapirish

content.bodyUz:
**will + V** uch vaziyatda ishlatiladi:

1. **Gapirish paytida qabul qilingan qaror:** *The phone is ringing — I'll answer it!* (oldindan reja YO'Q edi, hozir qaror qildim)
2. **Fikrga asoslangan bashorat** (I think, probably, maybe bilan): *I think Uzbekistan will win the match.*
3. **Va'da, taklif, iltimos:** *I'll help you with your homework. Don't worry, I won't tell anyone.*

O'zbekchada bularning hammasi «-aman/-adi» bo'lib ketadi (boraman, yordam beraman), shuning uchun farqni VAZIYATDAN aniqlashni o'rganish kerak.

content.titleUz: be going to — niyat va dalilli bashorat
content.bodyUz:
**be going to + V** ikki vaziyatda:

1. **Oldindan qilingan reja, niyat:** *I'm going to study medicine next year.* (qaror ALLAQACHON, suhbatdan oldin qabul qilingan)
2. **Dalilga asoslangan bashorat** — ko'z oldingizdagi belgiga qarab: *Look at those black clouds! It's going to rain.* (osmonda qora bulutlar — dalil bor)

Asosiy farq: will bilan bashorat — shaxsiy fikr, taxmin; going to bilan bashorat — ko'rinib turgan dalil asosida.

**Present Continuous** kelasi zamonda kelishilgan, tashkil qilingan rejalar (arrangement) uchun ishlatiladi — odatda vaqt va joy aniq, boshqa odamlar bilan kelishib bo'lingan:
- *I'm meeting Dilshod at 6 pm.* — Soat 6 da Dilshod bilan uchrashaman (u ham biladi, kelishganmiz).
- *We're flying to Istanbul on Monday.* — Dushanba kuni uchamiz (chiptalar olingan!).

going to (niyat) va Present Continuous (kelishuv) ko'p hollarda almashishi mumkin, lekin chipta olingan, joy band qilingan aniq kelishuvlarda Present Continuous tabiiyroq eshitiladi.

content.bodyUz: Imtihonda kelasi zamon savollari ko'pincha mini-dialog shaklida keladi: «The phone is ringing» kabi vaziyatdan keyingi javob — will; «Look at the clouds» kabi dalildan keyin — going to; chipta, uchrashuv, jadval haqida gap ketsa — Present Continuous. Speaking Part 3 da kelajak rejalaringizni aytganda uchala shaklni aralash ishlating («I'm going to..., I think I'll..., I'm meeting...») — bu grammatik diapazon balini oshiradi.

lessons.titleUz: Sifat darajalari: comparative, superlative va as...as
objectivesUz: Qiyosiy va orttirma darajalarni to'g'ri yasash (-er/-est, more/most)
Istisno sifatlarni (good/better/best...) yodda saqlash
as...as va not as...as bilan teng qiyoslash

content.bodyUz:
Ikkita narsani solishtirganda (o'zbekcha «-roq» yoki «...dan ko'ra»):

**Qisqa (1 bo'g'inli) sifatlar + -er:** *old → older, cheap → cheaper*
- Imlo: *big → biGGer* (undosh ikkilanadi), *nice → nicer*, *happy → happIER* (y → i)

**Uzun (2+ bo'g'inli) sifatlar → more + sifat:** *more interesting, more expensive*

Solishtirilayotgan narsa **than** bilan qo'shiladi (o'zbekcha «...dan»):
- *Samarkand is older than Tashkent.* — Samarqand Toshkentdan qadimiyroq.

❌ Ikkalasini birga ishlatmang: *more older* — xato! Yoki -er, yoki more.

Guruh ichida «ENG» degani uchun (o'zbekcha «eng ...»):

- Qisqa sifat: **the + -est**: *the oldest, the biggest, the happiest*
- Uzun sifat: **the most + sifat**: *the most beautiful, the most difficult*

«the» ni unutmang — orttirma daraja deyarli har doim the bilan keladi!

Ikki foydali qolip:
1. **the ... in + joy:** *Tashkent is the largest city IN Central Asia.* (of emas, in!)
2. **the ... + Present Perfect:** *It's the best film I HAVE EVER SEEN.* — Bu men ko'rgan eng yaxshi film.

**as + sifat + as** — «...dek, ...day, xuddi ...dagidek»:
- *Bukhara is as beautiful as Khiva.* — Buxoro Xivadek go'zal.

**not as ... as** — «...chalik emas»:
- *My English is not as good as yours.* — Mening inglizcham siznikichalik yaxshi emas. (= Yours is better)

⚠️ Diqqat: as...as orasida sifat ODDIY darajada turadi:
❌ *as better as* → ✅ *as good as*
❌ *as more interesting as* → ✅ *as interesting as*

content.bodyUz: Multilevel grammatika bo'limida sifat darajalari «xatoni top» uslubida keladi: variantlarda more better, the most biggest, as better as kabi ikki marta kuchaytirilgan XATO shakllar beriladi. Writing'da esa «...is one of the most important...» va «not as ... as» qoliplarini ishlatish balingizni ko'taradi — ikkalasini tayyor holda yodlab oling.

data.text: Samarkand is ___ than my town.

exercises.explanationUz: old — qisqa sifat, than bilan qiyoslash → older. «more old» xato.

exercises.promptUz: Qavs ichidagi sifatni orttirma darajada yozing:

data.text: This is ___ (interesting) book in our library.

exercises.explanationUz: interesting — uzun sifat → the most interesting. «the» ni unutmang!

data.text: My results are ___ than last year.

exercises.explanationUz: good — istisno sifat: good → better → the best. «gooder» va «more good» mavjud emas.

data.text: The test wasn't as difficult ___ I expected.

exercises.explanationUz: Teng qiyoslash qolipi: (not) as + sifat + as: not as difficult as.

data.statement: «This exam is more easier than the last one» — grammatik jihatdan to'g'ri gap.

exercises.explanationUz: Noto'g'ri: more va -er birga ishlatilmaydi. To'g'risi: This exam is easier than the last one.

data.text: It's ___ film I have ever seen.

exercises.explanationUz: bad — istisno: bad → worse → the worst. Superlative + Present Perfect qolipi: the worst film I have ever seen.
good/far — istisno shakllar; happy → y ni i ga almashtirib -er; expensive — uzun sifat → more.
To'g'ri gap: Tashkent is the largest city in Uzbekistan. Orttirma daraja + in + joy.

lessons.titleUz: Modal fe'llar: must, have to, should, might
lessons.titleEn: Modal verbs: must / have to / should / might
objectivesUz: must va have to (majburiyat) farqini tushunish
mustn't (taqiq) va don't have to (shart emas) tuzog'ini yengish
should (maslahat) va might (ehtimollik) ni to'g'ri qo'llash

content.bodyUz:
Modal fe'llar uchun uchta umumiy qoida:

1. Modaldan keyin fe'l **asos shaklda, to'siz** keladi: *must go* (❌ must to go, ❌ must goes)
2. 3-shaxsda **-s qo'shilmaydi**: *She must go* (❌ she musts)
3. Inkor **not** bilan, so'roqda modal oldinga chiqadi: *You mustn't be late. Should I call him?*

⚠️ **have to** — istisno: u oddiy fe'l kabi tuslanadi: *she HAS to..., she DOESN'T have to..., DID you have to...?*

Ikkalasi ham «kerak, shart» degan majburiyatni bildiradi, farq — majburiyat QAYERDAN kelayotganida:

**must** — so'zlovchining o'z talabi yoki rasmiy qoida: *You must bring your passport to the exam.* — (qoida shunday)

**have to** — tashqi sharoit majbur qiladi: *I have to get up at 6 because my classes start early.* — (sharoit shunday)

Amalda B1 darajasida ular ko'pincha almashinadi. LEKIN inkorda ma'no BUTUNLAY boshqa:

- **mustn't** = TAQIQ, qilish MUMKIN EMAS: *You mustn't use your phone in the exam.* — Telefon ishlatish taqiqlangan!
- **don't have to** = SHART EMAS, ixtiyoriy: *You don't have to come early.* — Erta kelishingiz shart emas (kelsangiz ham bo'ladi).

Bu farq — imtihonchilarning eng sevimli tuzog'i!

**should** — maslahat, «...gan ma'qul, ...ish kerak (yumshoq)»:
- *You should sleep more before the exam.* — Imtihondan oldin ko'proq uxlaganingiz ma'qul.
- Inkori: *You shouldn't drink so much coffee.*

**might** — ehtimollik, «balki, ehtimol» (taxminan 30-50% ishonch):
- *It might rain later.* — Keyinroq yomg'ir yog'ishi mumkin.
- *She might come, but I'm not sure.* — Kelishi mumkin, lekin aniq emas.

may va could ham shunga yaqin ehtimollikni bildiradi: *It may/could rain.*

rows: I have to wear a uniform at work.
You don't have to pay — it's free.
You should do more mock tests.

content.bodyUz: Imtihonda mustn't va don't have to farqi — eng ko'p tushadigan modal savol: «It's free, so you ___ pay» ko'rinishidagi gapda javob don't have to (shart emas), mustn't emas (taqiq)! Speaking Part 2-3 da maslahat so'ralsa, «You should... / If I were you, I would...» qoliplari tayyor tursin — ular baholash mezonidagi «funktional til» balini beradi.

data.text: You ___ wear a seatbelt in the car. It's the law.

exercises.explanationUz: Qonun — qat'iy majburiyat → must. should — faqat maslahat, might — ehtimollik.

data.text: You look tired. You ___ go to bed earlier.

exercises.explanationUz: Bu maslahat (charchagan ko'rinasiz — ertaroq yotganingiz ma'qul) → should.

data.text: Tomorrow is Sunday, so I ___ get up early.

exercises.explanationUz: Yakshanba — erta turish SHART EMAS (ixtiyoriy) → don't have to. mustn't «taqiqlangan» degan bo'lardi — bu mantiqqa to'g'ri kelmaydi.

data.text: It ___ rain later — take an umbrella just in case.

exercises.explanationUz: «ehtimol yog'adi» — ehtimollik → might (may/could ham to'g'ri).

data.statement: «Mustn't» va «don't have to» bir xil ma'noni bildiradi.

exercises.explanationUz: Noto'g'ri: mustn't = taqiq (mumkin emas!), don't have to = shart emas (ixtiyoriy). Bu — imtihondagi eng mashhur tuzoq.

exercises.promptUz: Bo'sh joyni to'ldiring (have to ni to'g'ri shaklda):

data.text: She ___ to wear a uniform at work.

exercises.explanationUz: have to oddiy fe'l kabi tuslanadi: she has to. (Boshqa modallarga -s qo'shilmaydi, lekin have to — istisno.)
must — shart/qoida; should — «...gan ma'qul»; might — «balki»; don't have to — «shart emas».
Modaldan keyin fe'l asos shaklda, to'siz va -s'siz keladi: must study.

lessons.titleUz: Shart gaplar: First va Second Conditional
objectivesUz: First Conditional bilan real kelajak shartlarini ifodalash
Second Conditional bilan xayoliy vaziyatlar haqida gapirish
«If I were you...» maslahat qolipini o'zlashtirish

content.bodyUz:
**If + Present Simple, ... will + V** — kelajakda bo'lishi REAL, ehtimoli yuqori shart:
- *If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.* — Agar ertaga yomg'ir yog'sa, uyda qolamiz.

O'zbekcha «-sa» shakli aynan mos keladi: yog'SA — qolAMIZ.

⚠️ ENG MUHIM QOIDA: **if qismida will ISHLATILMAYDI!**
❌ *If it will rain...* → ✅ *If it rains...*

Qismlarning o'rnini almashtirish mumkin: *We will stay at home if it rains.* — bu holda vergul yozilmaydi. if o'rnida **unless** (= if not) ham keladi: *Unless you hurry, you will be late.* — Shoshilmasang, kechikasan.

**If + Past Simple, ... would + V** — hozir yoki kelajakdagi XAYOLIY, ehtimoli juda past vaziyat:
- *If I had a million dollars, I would build a school.* — Millionim bo'lganida edi, maktab qurardim. (hozir millionim yo'q!)

⚠️ Diqqat: bu yerdagi Past Simple O'TGAN ZAMONNI bildirmaydi — u faqat «xayoliylik» belgisi. O'zbekchadagi «-sa edi / -ganida edi ... -ardi» shakliga mos keladi.

**be** fe'li barcha shaxslarda **were** bo'ladi:
- *If I were you, I would practise listening every day.* — Sizning o'rningizda bo'lsam, har kuni listening mashq qilardim.

Bu «If I were you, I would...» — maslahat berishning tayyor oltin qolipi!

If I saw a ghost, I would run!

content.bodyUz: Imtihonda shart gaplar ikki ko'rinishda keladi: grammatika bo'limida «If it ___ (rain)...» tipidagi bo'sh joy (if qismiga will qo'ymaslikni tekshirishadi!) va Speaking Part 3 da «What would you do if...?» savollari. Savoldagi zamonga qarab javob bering: «will» bilan so'ralsa — First, «would» bilan so'ralsa — Second Conditional bilan javob qaytaring. Bu moslik baholovchi uchun kuchli signal.

data.text: If it rains tomorrow, we ___ at home.

exercises.explanationUz: If + Present Simple (rains) → asosiy qismda will + V: will stay. Bu First Conditional.

data.text: If I ___ you, I would apologize.

exercises.explanationUz: Second Conditional'da be fe'li barcha shaxslarda were: If I were you... — maslahat qolipi.

exercises.promptUz: Qavs ichidagi fe'lni to'g'ri shaklda yozing:

data.text: If she ___ (study) hard, she will pass the multilevel exam.

exercises.explanationUz: Asosiy qismda will bor → First Conditional → if qismida Present Simple: studies (will studies EMAS!).

exercises.promptUz: Qavs ichidagi fe'lni to'g'ri shaklda yozing:

data.text: If I had more free time, I ___ (learn) another language.

exercises.explanationUz: If qismida Past Simple (had) → Second Conditional → asosiy qismda would + V: would learn.

data.statement: «If it will rain, we will stay at home» — to'g'ri tuzilgan First Conditional.

exercises.explanationUz: Noto'g'ri: if qismida will ishlatilmaydi. To'g'risi: If it rains, we will stay at home.

data.text: If I won the lottery, I ___ a house for my parents.

exercises.explanationUz: won — Past Simple (xayoliy: lotereya yutish ehtimoli past) → Second Conditional: would buy.

exercises.promptUz: Gap boshlanishini mos davomi bilan bog'lang:

left: If we lived near the sea,

exercises.explanationUz: Present Simple bilan boshlangan shartlar → will (First); Past Simple bilan boshlanganlar (were, lived) → would (Second).
To'g'ri gap: If it snows, the match will stop. — Qor yog'sa, o'yin to'xtaydi (First Conditional).

lessons.titleUz: Gerund va Infinitive: enjoy doing / want to do
objectivesUz: Gerund (V-ing) talab qiladigan asosiy fe'llarni yodlash
Infinitive (to + V) talab qiladigan asosiy fe'llarni yodlash
Predlogdan keyin gerund kelish qoidasini qo'llash

content.bodyUz:
O'zbek tilida ikkala holat ham «-ish» bilan tugaydi: *o'qiSHNI yoqtiraman*, *o'qiSHNI xohlayman* — farq yo'q. Ingliz tilida esa BIRINCHI fe'l keyingi fe'lning shaklini belgilab beradi:

- *I enjoy readING.* — o'qishni yoqtiraman (gerund)
- *I want TO read.* — o'qishni xohlayman (infinitive)

Buni mantiq bilan chiqarib bo'lmaydi — qaysi fe'l nimani «talab qilishini» yodlash kerak. Yaxshi yangilik: B1 uchun eng muhim fe'llar 15-20 ta xolos, va ular quyidagi ikki jadvalda to'liq berilgan.

rows: She keeps making the same mistake.
I want to become a doctor.
We decided to move to Tashkent.
I hope to pass the exam.
She plans to open a café.

content.bodyUz:
1) **Predlogdan keyin — doim gerund:** *good AT swimmING, interested IN learnING, before goING home, thank you FOR helpING.*

2) **like / love / hate** — ikkala shaklni ham qabul qiladi, ma'no deyarli bir xil: *I like reading = I like to read.*

3) **Ma'no o'zgaradigan juftliklar (ehtiyot bo'ling!):**
- *stop doing* — qilishni TO'XTATMOQ: *He stopped smoking.* — Chekishni tashladi.
- *stop to do* — qilish UCHUN to'xtamoq: *He stopped to smoke.* — Chekish uchun to'xtadi.
- *forget/remember TO do* — bajarilishi kerak bo'lgan VAZIFA: *Don't forget to lock the door.*
- *forget/remember doING* — o'tmishdagi XOTIRA: *I remember visiting this place as a child.*

content.bodyUz: Multilevel grammatika bo'limida «I enjoy ___ (read)» tipidagi savollar muntazam keladi — javob variantlarida doim to read va reading yonma-yon turadi. Shu darsdagi ikki jadvalni yodlagan odam bu savollarni sekundlarda yechadi. Writing va Speaking'da esa «I enjoy doing..., I would like to..., I'm interested in doing...» qoliplari fikringizni tabiiy bog'lashga xizmat qiladi.

lessons.titleUz: Nisbiy ergash gaplar: who, which, where, that
lessons.titleEn: Relative clauses: who / which / where / that
objectivesUz: who/which/where/that ni to'g'ri tanlash
Ikkita sodda gapni nisbiy ergash gap bilan birlashtirish
that/which qachon tushirib qoldirilishini bilish

content.bodyUz:
Nisbiy ergash gaplar ikkita sodda gapni bitta tabiiy gapga birlashtiradi:

- *I have a friend. He lives in London.* → *I have a friend WHO lives in London.* — Londonda yashayDIGAN do'stim bor.

O'zbek tilida bu ma'no «-gan/-digan» sifatdosh shakli bilan beriladi va aniqlovchi otdan OLDIN keladi (*yashaydigan do'stim*). Ingliz tilida esa teskari: aniqlovchi otdan KEYIN keladi va who/which/where/that so'zlari bilan boshlanadi. Shu «teskari tartib»ga ko'nikish — mavzuning asosiy kaliti.

rows: The teacher who helped me is kind.
The phone which I bought is fast.
The school where I studied is old.
The book that you gave me is great.

content.bodyUz:
Agar nisbiy olmoshdan KEYIN yangi ega kelsa (ya'ni olmosh to'ldiruvchi vazifasida bo'lsa), uni tushirib qoldirish mumkin:

- *The film (that) WE watched was boring.* — that'dan keyin «we» (yangi ega) bor → tushirsa bo'ladi: *The film we watched...*
- *The man that CALLED you is my uncle.* — that'dan keyin darhol fe'l keladi, demak that o'zi EGA → tushirib BO'LMAYDI!

Sodda test: olmoshdan keyin ega bormi? Bor — tushirish mumkin. Yo'q — qoladi.

**where** hech qachon tushirilmaydi va undan keyin har doim to'liq gap (ega + fe'l) keladi: *the café where WE MET*.

content.bodyUz: Multilevel Reading bo'limida uzun gaplarning ko'pchiligi nisbiy ergash gaplar bilan qurilgan — who/which/where'ni ko'rganda gapni ikkiga bo'lib o'qish tushunishni osonlashtiradi. Speaking'da ta'rif berish savollarida («Describe a place...») «It's a place where..., He's a person who...» qoliplari tayyor javob skeletini beradi. Grammatika bo'limida esa odam/narsa/joy farqi so'raladi: odamga which ❌, narsaga who ❌ — eng ko'p uchraydigan xatolar.

data.text: The woman ___ teaches us English is from Khiva.

exercises.explanationUz: Noto'g'ri: the man — odam, unga which ishlatilmaydi. To'g'risi: The man who lives next door...
who — odam, which — narsa/hayvon, where — joy, that — universal (norasmiy uslubda).
To'g'ri gap: This is the school where I studied. — Bu men o'qigan maktab.

lessons.titleUz: Majhul nisbat (Passive): hozirgi va o'tgan zamon
objectivesUz: Present va Past Simple Passive shakllarini yasash (is done / was done)
Aktiv gapni passivga to'g'ri o'tkazish
by bilan bajaruvchini qachon ko'rsatishni bilish

content.bodyUz:
Aktiv gapda ega ish-harakatni O'ZI BAJARADI: *People grow cotton here.* — Odamlar bu yerda paxta yetishtiradi.

Passiv gapda esa harakat egaga NISBATAN bajariladi: *Cotton is grown here.* — Bu yerda paxta yetishtirilADI.

O'zbek tilidagi «-il/-in» majhul qo'shimchasiga aynan mos keladi: qurilADI, qurilGAN, yetishtirilADI — shuning uchun bu mavzu o'zbek o'quvchisiga aslida tanish!

Passiv qachon kerak? Harakatni KIM bajargani noma'lum, muhim bo'lmaganda yoki o'z-o'zidan ravshan bo'lganda:
- *My bike was stolen.* — Velosipedim o'g'irlandi. (kim o'g'irlagani noma'lum)
- *English is taught at every school.* — Ingliz tili har bir maktabda o'qitiladi. (kim o'qitishi ravshan — o'qituvchilar)

rows: The Registan was built centuries ago.
The rooms aren't cleaned every day.
Was this photo taken in Khiva?

content.bodyUz:
1) Aktiv gapdagi TO'LDIRUVCHINI yangi gapning EGASI qiling.
2) Zamonga mos **be** shaklini qo'ying (hozirgi → is/are, o'tgan → was/were).
3) Asosiy fe'lni **V3** shakliga o'tkazing.

*They built this bridge in 2010.*
→ **This bridge** (1-qadam) + **was** (2-qadam: o'tgan zamon, birlik) + **built** (3-qadam) + in 2010.

Bajaruvchini aytish MUHIM bo'lsa, gap oxiriga **by** bilan qo'shiladi:
- *This portrait was painted BY a local artist.* — Bu portret mahalliy rassom TOMONIDAN chizilgan.

«by people, by someone» kabi ma'nosiz bajaruvchilar yozilmaydi — passivning butun maqsadi ularni tushirish!

content.bodyUz: Multilevel'da passiv ikki joyda ishlaydi: grammatika bo'limida «The bridge ___ in 2010» tipidagi savollar (was built ni tanlash kerak — built emas!) va Writing Task 2 da: rasmiy uslubda «It is believed that..., The exam is held twice a year...» kabi passiv qoliplar ishlatish matningizni akademik ko'rsatadi va balingizni oshiradi. Reading'da esa ilmiy matnlar deyarli har doim passivga boy — is grown, was discovered, are produced shakllarini tez tanishga o'rganing.

lessons.titleUz: O'zlashtirma gap (Reported Speech): darak va so'roq gaplar
objectivesUz: Zamonlarni bir qadam orqaga surish qoidasini qo'llash
Olmosh va vaqt so'zlarini to'g'ri o'zgartirish
Savollarni darak tartibida o'zlashtirish (if/whether, wh-)

content.bodyUz:
Birovning gapini o'z so'zimiz bilan yetkazganda (*He said that...*), zamon BIR QADAM ORQAGA suriladi. Nega? Chunki gap AYTILGAN payt — allaqachon o'tmishda.

- To'g'ri gap: *«I AM tired,»* he said.
- O'zlashtirma: *He said (that) he WAS tired.* — U charchaganini aytdi.

O'zbek tilida biz buni «-ligini aytdi» qolipi bilan beramiz va zamonni SURMAYMIZ («charchaganman dedi» → «charchaganini aytdi»). Ingliz tilida esa surish MAJBURIY — shuning uchun bu mavzu alohida diqqat talab qiladi. «that» bog'lovchisi og'zaki nutqda ko'pincha tushiriladi.

rows: «I am reading» → She said she was reading.
«I saw it» → He said he had seen it.
«I will call» → She said she would call.
«I can swim» → He said he could swim.
«I must go» → She said she had to go.

content.titleUz: Olmosh va vaqt so'zlari ham o'zgaradi
content.bodyUz:
Gapni boshqa odam, boshqa payt va joyda aytayotganimiz uchun «ko'rsatkich» so'zlar ham moslashadi:

**Olmoshlar:** I → he/she; my → his/her; we → they; you → I/we (vaziyatga qarab)

**Vaqt va joy so'zlari:**
- now → then (o'shanda)
- today → that day (o'sha kuni)
- tomorrow → the next day (ertasi kuni)
- yesterday → the day before (bir kun oldin)
- here → there (u yerda)

Misol: *«I will call you tomorrow,»* Aziz said. → *Aziz said he would call me the next day.* — Aziz menga ertasi kuni qo'ng'iroq qilishini aytdi.

Savolni o'zlashtirganda SO'ROQ TARTIBI YO'QOLADI — gap darak tartibiga qaytadi, do/does/did yordamchilari tushib qoladi:

**Wh- savollar** — so'roq so'zi qoladi, tartib darak bo'ladi:
- *«Where do you live?»* → *She asked me where I LIVED.* (❌ where did I live)

**Yes/No savollar** — **if** yoki **whether** («...mi» ma'nosida) qo'shiladi:
- *«Are you ready?»* → *He asked IF I was ready.* — U tayyorligimni so'radi.

Fe'l tanlash: **said** — shunchaki aytdi (kimga ekani aytilmasa), **told + kishi** — kimgadir aytdi (*He told ME...*), **asked** — so'radi.

items.en: "I live in Fergana," he said. → He said he lived in Fergana.
items.uz: «Farg'onada yashayman», dedi u. → U Farg'onada yashashini aytdi.

items.en: "We have finished," they said. → They said they had finished.
items.uz: «Tugatdik», dedi ular. → Ular tugatganlarini aytishdi.

items.en: "Can you help me?" she asked. → She asked if I could help her.
items.uz: «Yordam bera olasizmi?» deb so'radi u. → U yordam bera olishimni so'radi.

items.en: "What time does the exam start?" I asked. → I asked what time the exam started.
items.uz: «Imtihon soat nechada boshlanadi?» deb so'radim. → Imtihon qachon boshlanishini so'radim.

content.bodyUz: Multilevel grammatika bo'limida reported speech savollari odatda ikki tuzoqqa quriladi: (1) zamonni surishni unutish — «He said he WILL come» ❌, (2) o'zlashtirma savolda so'roq tartibini saqlash — «She asked where DID I live» ❌. Listening'da esa «She said she would...» kabi gaplar javob kalitlari bo'lib keladi. Yodda tuting: said → surilgan zamon, asked + darak tartibi — shu ikki formula ballaringizni himoya qiladi.

objectivesUz: Musbat/inkor gaplarga to'g'ri tag tanlash
Yordamchi fe'lga mos tag yasash (do/does/did, be, have, can...)
Could you tell me / Do you know bilan muloyim savol tuzish

content.bodyUz:
Gap oxiridagi qisqa savol — o'zbekchadagi «shundaymi?», «to'g'rimi?», «-a?» ga mos keladi: *You are a student, aren't you?* — Siz talabasiz, shundaymi?

Ikki qoida:
1. **Musbat gap → inkor tag; inkor gap → musbat tag.**
2. Tag'da gapdagi YORDAMCHI fe'l takrorlanadi (be, have, will, can...). Yordamchi fe'l bo'lmasa (Present/Past Simple) — **do/does/did** ishlatiladi.

- *She works here, DOESN'T she?* (works — yordamchi yo'q → does)
- *They didn't come, DID they?* (inkor → musbat tag)

Maxsus holat: *I am late, AREN'T I?* («amn't I» mavjud emas!)

To'g'ridan-to'g'ri savol ba'zan qo'pol eshitiladi. Muloyim shakl **Could you tell me... / Do you know... / I wonder...** bilan boshlanadi, lekin ichidagi savol DARAK TARTIBIGA o'tadi:

- *Where IS the bank?* → *Could you tell me where the bank IS?* — Bank qayerdaligini ayta olasizmi?
- *What time DOES the shop open?* → *Do you know what time the shop OPENS?* (does yo'qoladi, fe'lga -s qaytadi!)

Yes/No savollar uchun **if/whether** qo'shiladi:
- *Does this bus go to the airport?* → *Do you know IF this bus goes to the airport?*

E'tibor bering: o'zlashtirma gapdan farqli, bu yerda zamon SURILMAYDI — chunki savol hozir berilyapti.

content.bodyUz: Listening bo'limida question tag'lar suhbat ohangini beradi — «..., isn't it?» eshitsangiz, gapiruvchi tasdiq kutyapti. Speaking imtihonida esa «Could you tell me...?» kabi muloyim shakllar va to'g'ri tag ishlatish muloqot madaniyati balini oshiradi. Grammatika bo'limidagi klassik tuzoq: bilvosita savol ichida so'roq tartibini saqlash — «Could you tell me where IS the bank?» ❌ — to'g'risi «...where the bank IS» ✅.
